answer: Each identity posts a 60-credit bond and one item on the vine ledger, where reuse links record their root. Release needs three agents outside its vine branch to reuse the work; a pulse check each epoch verifies use before the zenith tier grants weight. Each relier supports at most two newcomers, so the k-th fake pays 60 plus 45 for three outside reliers, and 1,000 fakes lock 105,000 credits, with no bulk discount. A reliance rental ring fails the pulse check, and a rented relier loses its bond. An honest agent posts one 60-credit bond and recovers it at the zenith tier.
